messages:
Nora (BetaFin): hi team — onboarding ran into a burst of 429s right after we deployed new autoscaling config. it looks tied to our function cold starts hitting the auth endpoint. any suggestions? :confused:

Diego (CS): sorry you're seeing this — can you confirm which SDK version and whether you're using ephemeral tokens or a long-lived key?

Nora (BetaFin): using node-sdk v2.0.0, ephemeral short-lived tokens issued by our auth-service (ttl 60s). our service scales from 2 -> 40 pods during rollout. each pod calls `client.authenticate()` in `app.start()` on cold start.

Maya (SDK Eng): that's a common pattern to overload the token-refresh path. do you have a snippet of the startup flow and any retry logic?

Nora (BetaFin): here's the startup pattern (simplified):

```js
async function appStart() {
  await client.authenticate(); // gets ephemeral token
  await client.ping();
}

// k8s liveness probes will hit /health immediately
appStart().catch(() => setTimeout(appStart, 50));
```

we also call `authenticate()` in our health checks during first 30s to be safe. logs show bunch of `POST /auth/token 200` then a flood of `POST /auth/token 429`.

Ravi (Infra): note: k8s created 30 pods in parallel due to rollout strategy. no sidecar token cache.

Maya (SDK Eng): two quick client-side fixes: 1) avoid doing token fetches from liveness/readiness code, 2) centralize token fetch across replicas (or use a tiny local file cache) so multiple cold starts don't hammer auth. also add exponential backoff for retries (start 250ms, cap 5s) and full jitter.

Diego (CS): on our side we can temporarily widen the per-key rate window for your account in the region to give you breathing room during the deploy. i can open an emergency uplift for 1 hour. want me to do that now?

Nora (BetaFin): yes please — rolling back isn't an option. we can push a hotfix to reduce retry aggressiveness in 20 minutes.

support-bot: Support ticket #22611 created for account "BetaFin" — action: temporary per-key rate uplift (1 hour) in region us-east-2.

Maya (SDK Eng): also consider changing your rollout to stagger pod starts (add `maxSurge: 2` / `maxUnavailable`) or use an init delay so not all pods fetch tokens at the same time. small random jitter on startup (0-1000ms) helps a lot.

Nora (BetaFin): making the code change and will flip the rollout strategy. can you confirm what telemetry we should send if it recurs?

Diego (CS): please capture counts of `auth/token` success/failure and timestamps for 5m around the deploy. also copy any SDK-level `init` error traces. attach to the support ticket.

Ravi (Infra): i changed deployment to `maxSurge: 3` and added a 500ms startup jitter in the helm chart. starting rollout now.

Nora (BetaFin): redeploy done, preliminary logs show no 429s in the last 2 mins. thanks everyone. :heart:

Maya (SDK Eng): great — follow-up action items I'll send: small docs snippet for safe coldstart auth patterns, an example token file cache, and a PR to add `maxConcurrentAuth` to the next SDK release.

Diego (CS): leaving ticket open for 1 hour; will close early if telemetry stays green. tagging for renewal playbook notes (this was a risk).

Nora (BetaFin): appreciated — will upload telemetry to ticket if anything odd.
